descriptor: Hosted-Inference Access-Regime Reconstitution, Frozen-Task Re-entry Constitution, Provider/Model Substitution Non-Equivalence, Missingness-Geometry Audit, Bounded Salvage Authority & Cross-Task Measurement-Law Reopening

theoretical_reframing.problem: Raw-row completeness and estimand completeness are not the same scientific object. P53 was constitutionally blocked because 416 rows remained technically missing, but the primary P53 estimand is a stopping-time profile. Missing rows that occur after a stopping time, or whose paired semantic twin already forces joint failure, may be irrelevant to that estimand.
theoretical_reframing.new_question: Can the frozen P53 primary measurement-law estimand be exactly identified from the incomplete P54 receipt without imputing outcomes or changing the P53 tests, and if not, what is the smallest same-model evidence boundary that would be scientifically relevant for lawful re-entry?
theoretical_reframing.access_question: Has same-model hosted access reappeared sufficiently to justify a future bounded replay stage, without confusing a small access canary with proof of bulk capacity?

missingness_geometry: failure counts by model, task, draw, semantic, vertex, schedule position and error class
late-draw concentration and first/last observed failure
no MCAR/MAR assumption and no provider-internal causal claim
estimand_identifiability: For each task×vertex, reconstruct J(draw)=valid_correct AND null_correct as 0 whenever either observed twin is false, 1 when both observed twins are true, and unknown only when missingness can still change the conjunction.
Enumerate all reachable stopping times tau at width 0.50 under every completion of unknown J draws by finite-state dynamic programming.
A tau is exactly identified iff its reachable set is a singleton.
The original six P53 Gemini primary tests may be run unchanged only if all 96 Gemini task×vertex stopping times are exactly identified.
bounded_critical_rows: If the primary estimand is not fully identified, enumerate only missing semantic rows belonging to unresolved J draws at or before the latest reachable stopping time for their task×vertex.
This set is an upper bound on scientifically relevant same-model replay rows; no P55 scientific replay is authorized.
substitution_non_equivalence: Use already-observed matched P53 Gemini/GPT-OSS cells only.
Any matched correctness or joint-outcome discordance is sufficient to reject literal provider/model substitution as a lawful fill for missing Gemini rows.
A substitute model may at most support a future sensitivity bridge; it cannot inherit the original Gemini estimand.

bounded_access_probe.object: response-contract canary only; never a P53 task cell
bounded_access_probe.gate: 3/3 exact canary successes on an interface indicate current point-access only. It does not certify capacity for hundreds of scientific calls.

reopening_authority.primary_reopen: If all 96 Gemini tau values are exactly identified, run the frozen P53 six-test family and Holm correction unchanged. Zero-shot policy transfer remains blocked because it requires complete response matrices.
reopening_authority.future_reentry: If primary tau is not fully identified but Gemini access canary is 3/3, P55 may authorize a NEW future stage to replay only the estimand-critical same-model Gemini rows. P55 itself performs no scientific replay.
reopening_authority.no_substitution: GPT-OSS or any other provider/model cannot replace missing Gemini rows in the primary P53 estimand.

killed: Missing-data partial identification is prior art.
Model substitution and domain adaptation are prior art.
API availability probing is engineering, not a scientific contribution.
novelty_kill.surviving_candidate: An estimand-specific recovery constitution for hosted-inference experiments: distinguish raw-row missingness from exact identifiability of a sequential stopping-time estimand, reject model substitution as literal completion, and reduce future replay authority to only estimand-critical missing rows.

literature_pressure: Manski (2005), Partial Identification with Missing Data.
Hosted-inference nondeterminism and evaluation literature already in EPISTEME Harvest.
Classical missing-data ignorability/coarsening concepts are background only; P55 makes no ignorability assumption.
frozen_rules: No P53 task prompt, threshold, seed, test, Holm family or branch ordering changes.
No missing outcome is imputed probabilistically.
P55 may issue exactly six non-scientific access-canary calls and zero scientific-cell replays.
A successful canary does not itself authorize bulk replay.
Provider/model substitution cannot restore original-model authority.
No provider-internal cause is inferred from missingness timing or error strings.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P55.

preflight_correction.failure: manifest JSON syntax only; no canaries or scientific calls executed
